main.description: Generic constant-return / identity primitive for LangGraph topology nodes (ADR-2605082000 §2.6 PoC follow-up). Returns whatever is in `constant` verbatim. Lets identity / no-op nodes (e.g. ki.cycle.skip_bloom) live as data without requiring per-actor code. Inputs other than `constant` are ignored.

constant.description: Object returned verbatim under the result envelope. Required.

schema.description: Echoes the input `constant` field as the response object.

constant.description: The same object that was supplied in the input.
